description: A JSON document whose text carries accents, an em dash, a currency sign, and an emoji. Multi-byte characters shift every later byte offset, so this is where a decoded range and a source range diverge for reasons that have nothing to do with escaping.

slots.name: accented
slots.label: person_name
slots.note: Three multi-byte characters inside the name itself, so its own byte length exceeds its character count and every value after it sits further into the file.
